headline: Satin Creditcare subsidiary SGAL invests ₹5 crore in Indic Wisdom
summary: Satin Growth Alternatives Limited, a subsidiary of Satin Creditcare Network Limited, has made its first investment of ₹5 crore in Indic Wisdom. The capital, structured as NCDs and CCPS, will fund manufacturing scale-up and distribution expansion.

headline: Kec International wins Rs 1303 crore order from multiple clients
summary: Confirmed work order for T&D and cables across India, Middle East, and Americas. Adds to backlog covering 1.76 quarters of revenue. Order inflow stable after Q1FY27 surge.

headline: Info Edge appoints Himanshu Agarwal as CFO
summary: Info Edge (India) Ltd appoints Himanshu Agarwal as CFO and Additional Director, replacing interim CFO Ambarish Raghuvanshi. Naresh Chand Gupta joins as Independent Director.

headline: Poojaa Precision hosts investor meet on Sep 17
summary: Poojaa Precision Engg. Ltd will host an investor meeting on September 17, 2026, in Pune, Chakan, and Mumbai. The session is open to investors via in-person or virtual modes.

headline: Supra Pacific Financial to issue ₹50 crore NCDs
summary: Supra Pacific Financial Services Ltd schedules board meeting on September 17, 2026, to approve issuance of secured, unrated NCDs worth ₹50 crore via private placement.

headline: JK Bank AGM addendum: Tharchin joins board
summary: Jammu and Kashmir Bank issued an addendum for its 88th AGM on September 22, 2026. The notice adds the appointment of Tsewang Tharchin as a director and notes the retirement of R. K. Chhibber.

headline: Paisalo Digital to host investor meet in Dubai
summary: Paisalo Digital Limited will conduct a non-deal roadshow in Dubai from September 17 to 19, 2026. The event includes physical group and one-on-one meetings with institutional investors.

headline: Om Galaxy IPO Day 3: Subscription hits 1.02x
summary: Om Galaxy IPO is subscribed 1.02x on Day 3. QIBs lead with 3.11x demand. Issue closes on 15-09-2026. Check category-wise breakdown and offer details.

headline: Coforge Announces TechCon 2026 Global AI Event
summary: Coforge Limited announced TechCon 2026, its flagship global technology event focusing on enterprise AI adoption and workforce readiness. The event will feature a company-wide hackathon with over 3,000 participants.

headline: Manika Plastech IPO Day 2: Retail leads demand
summary: Manika Plastech IPO is subscribed 1.31x on Day 2. Retail investors lead with 2.08x subscription, while QIB remains at 0x. Check full category-wise breakdown and offer details.

headline: Raksan Transformers IPO Day 3: Subscription Stagnant at 1.38x
summary: Raksan Transformers IPO subscription remains flat at 1.38x on Day 3. QIB leads with 3.87x demand, while Retail and NII categories show modest interest. Issue closes on September 15, 2026.

headline: Maharaja and Speedex IPO Day 3: Subscription Stalls
summary: Maharaja and Speedex IPO subscription remains at 0.52x on Day 3. QIB demand is zero, while NII (sHNI) leads with 1.34x. Issue closes on September 15, 2026.

headline: Injecto Polymers IPO Day 2: Subscription Stagnant at 0.29x
summary: Injecto Polymers IPO sees no growth on Day 2, remaining at 0.29x. QIB leads with 1.02x while Retail and NII lag. Issue closes on September 16, 2026.

headline: Panchatv Bharat IPO Day 3: Subscription Stagnant at 0.09x
summary: Panchatv Bharat IPO sees no fresh bids on Day 3. Total subscription remains flat at 0.09x with zero QIB interest. Issue closes on September 15, 2026.

headline: Veegaland Developers IPO Day 3 Subscription Update
summary: Veegaland Developers IPO is subscribed 1.14x on Day 3. Retail leads at 1.62x, while QIB demand remains flat at 0.45x. Check full subscription status and offer details.

headline: Century Business Media IPO Day 2: Subscription Stagnant
summary: Century Business Media IPO subscription remains at 1.14x on Day 2. QIB leads with 3.51x. Issue closes on 16-09-2026.
